note: The single place that says which recordings Strum Along ships. strumalong/tools/build-songs.js reads it; paths are relative to the repo root. Founder direction (25 Oct 2026): strumming songs only, ordered by difficulty level. Quick-change line is 40 changes a minute (25 Oct 2026; one chord per bar at 120 BPM is 30 a minute, which is not a quick-change pace).
